summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held May 6, 2026, which approved the election of two new Executive Officers, Carlos Plachta and Raphael Franco de Campos, to fill positions related to consumer market/logistics and operations, respectively, completing the current term ending after the 2027 Annual Shareholders Meeting. The election followed a shareholder agreement among Novonor S.A., NSP Investimentos S.A., and Petrobras. This appears as a routine executive replacement, not a forced departure, and does not involve a special-situation event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report.
